profile.headline: Web Developer at Half Price Books
profile.summary:
I am a full stack web developer with a background in web and graphic design and marketing. I have completed my certifications for full stack web development in Python, Ruby on Rails, and the MEAN stack. I enjoy to continue to learn as it is what drives me to keep me moving forward and discovering new opportunities.

I am currently seeking a web development position and am eager to grow my skills. I look forward to joining a team that will facilitate my growth through teamwork, continued learning, and experience. 

If interested, feel free to contact me. Email:rebeccareitzammer@gmail.com

positions.title: Developer in Training
positions.description: Coding Dojo is a coding bootcamp teaching full stacks for Python, Ruby on Rails, and MEAN. The goal is to teach students how to learn a full stack in any language for this fast-paced industry, how to be self sufficient, and how to keep learning when technology changes. You experience teamwork, as well as individual work, through class work and projects which help students prepare and add benefit to any company.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description: At the Salvation Army, I managed, designed, created TSA websites across the state of Texas through the Wordpress platform using HTML and CSS3. Managed, created, and designed email campaigns through the Salesforce platform. Managed and delivered strategies for technical SEO and on-page SEO.

positions.title: Brand Manager
positions.description: At Roma Boots, I managed all email and social media marketing. On average, I sent out 500,00 emails monthly to our subscriber base. I created all graphics using my skills in photography, Photoshop and Illustrator to create emails, social media posts, retargeting ads and marketing materials. I also managed the Roma Boots site through the Shopify platform by updating front page images, videos, product images, SEO or faulty links on the site. Updates were made on the Shopify platform through theme customizations or by manually editing the code to thoroughly make sure the site was running smoothly.

positions.title: Owner and Creator
positions.description: Minted Bow Boutique was a trendy fast fashion women's boutique. As the owner, I managed  all buying, administrative duties, financial accounts, marketing, and Shopify website. I also created and implemented graphics and photography for the website and other marketing efforts.

positions.title: Executive Assistant
positions.description: At Marketocracy, I coordinated HR tasks, such as, keeping track of PTO and transferring money to proper accounts to ensure employees salaries are paid. Supervised and managed all bank accounts, bills and bookkeeping for QuickBooks as well as prepare financial reports/data. I managed and prioritized incoming mail, maintained the company filing system, and created/organized marketing propaganda. I also executed official corporate projects such as creating and issuing stock certificates for all investors and verifying rankings/corporate actions for Marketocracy members. I handled travel arrangements for the President and other executives. Assisted with technical support with minor coding for the live website.

positions.title: Store Manager/Coordinator
positions.description: At Rosa Clara, I coordinated all promotional and marketing events to build brand recognition and awareness, maintained and developed relationships with vendors in the wedding industry, responsible for all purchasing and planning, consulted and managed client customers base to ensure top quality service, and managed social media accounts such as Facebook and blogging.

positions.title: Assistant Salon Director/Visual Merchandiser
positions.description: At Toni & Guy, I managed a team that consisted of stylists, colour techs, apprentices and receptionists, coordinated and led monthly meetings, managed work schedules, vacations, clients and responsible for merit reviews of staff, and managed the salon’s product and overhead costs excluding assets and labor. As the visual merchandiser, I attended visual merchandising seminars at TIGI headquarters to learn more about products and marketing campaigns to push products sales in the salon, managed promotions offered to clients as well as product placement in the salon to maximize sales and brand exposure, and assisted in audit inventory and retail orders for the salon.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Ruby on Rails, and MEAN Stack, Full Stack Web Development

volunteerExperiences.description: Life Changing. You do not realize the privileges you are blessed with till you visit a country that has so much poverty. The need was great and I was honored to be given the opportunity to help and share the love of Jesus Christ.

Girls Inc. provides an after school program for at risk youth girls. My duties at Girls Inc. were to help with homework, teacher assistance for lectures, fill in for teachers when they were not able to come in, and anything else that needed an extra helping hand.
